text: If you were bracing for a soggy Friday, relax, the front's basically done its business already. Those morning showers have mostly cleared out, and even though it's mostly cloudy and a little muggy right now at 75, that's about to change fast. The wind's swinging out of the north, and that's your signal clearing skies and sunshine are on the way through the afternoon. NWS has the high near 73, though the American and European models both nudge a touch warmer, so don't be shocked if we creep into the mid 70s before it's done. There's a small chance of a stray shower or rumble lingering into early afternoon, but I wouldn't plan around it, the Euro's the outlier there and I'd bet on drying out. Once that sun takes over this evening, it's a genuinely nice one, light winds, comfortable air, clear skies settling in. Good evening to be outside anytime after 3 or so, and if you're near the water, winds go light and waves lay down under a foot by tonight.
